description: Payment mode with the required type and captureMethod. Pins Automatic, the value platforms used when captureMethod was omitted.

platformOnly.intentConfiguration.confirmationTokenCon: iOS IntentConfiguration holds the confirmation token handler; Android keeps its IntentConfiguration free of handlers and registers the callback on PaymentSheet.Builder.
platformOnly.sheet.paymentSheetCallbackKind: Android PaymentSheetManager picks the confirmation token callback for PaymentSheet.Builder from the handler JS sends; iOS asserts the handler at intentConfiguration.confirmationTokenConfirmHandler.

unasserted.params.intentConfiguration.mode.type: The builder consumes mode.type to choose payment or setup. Native code asserts the resulting mode, not this discriminator.
